key.name: dock-size
key.description: Height for BOTTOM/TOP, width for LEFT/RIGHT

key.name: dock-alignment
key.description: START, CENTER, or END — horizontal for BOTTOM/TOP, vertical for LEFT/RIGHT

key.name: launcher-spacing
key.summary: Spacing between app icons in pixels

key.name: preview-spacing
key.summary: Spacing between window thumbnails in pixels

key.name: launcher-hover-zoom
key.description: 100 = no zoom, 150 = scale to 1.5× on hover

key.name: preview-hover-zoom
key.description: 100 = no zoom, 150 = scale to 1.5× on hover

key.name: thumbnail-height
key.description: All thumbnails are scaled to this height; width follows the window aspect ratio

key.name: use-theme-colors
key.summary: Use the shell theme for dock styling
key.description: When true, clears all custom inline styles so the active GNOME Shell theme styles the dock

key.name: dock-padding
key.summary: Internal padding between the dock edge and its contents

key.name: edge-margin
key.summary: Gap between the dock and the screen edge in pixels

key.name: outer-border-width
key.summary: Outer border width in pixels (0 = no border)

key.name: hide-dash
key.summary: Hide the built-in GNOME Shell dash
key.description: Hides the standard dash from the overview so only GDash is visible

key.name: window-right-click
key.summary: Action when right-clicking a window thumbnail

key.name: window-middle-click
key.summary: Action when middle-clicking a window thumbnail

key.name: show-all-workspaces
key.description: When false, only the current workspace is shown
